label: Bible Study
prompt: And when the _____, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
verse: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
note: A Roman officer at the foot of the cross gives the Gospel's great verdict.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: My beloved is _____, and I am his: he feedeth among the lilies.
verse: My beloved is mine, and I am his: he feedeth among the lilies.
note: My beloved is mine, and I am his — the Song's refrain of belonging, echoed again in 6:3.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two _____, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.
verse: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.
note: The Samaritan paid the innkeeper two pence and promised to cover the rest — mercy with an open tab.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And no marvel; for Satan himself is _____ into an angel of light.
verse: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.
note: Paul's warning about false apostles: deception rarely shows up looking dark — it dresses as light.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The wind bloweth where it _____, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
verse: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
note: 'The wind bloweth where it listeth' — where it pleases. Jesus to Nicodemus, by night, on being born of the Spirit.
